subject: Nimbus pilot: observability onboarding and success criteria (recap + next steps)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Watson <emily.watson@nimbus.ai>, Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus pilot: quick recap and POC scope confirmation

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick written recap so we have alignment before Marissa kicks off the technical onramp next week. Action items and assumptions below; please confirm or flag changes.

Scope we discussed
- 2-week pilot (proof of workload parity + observability) against 200k inference tokens/day simulated traffic.
- Models: rwd-open-7b (quantized) and rwd-open-13b (float16) for latency/cost comparison.
- Primary success focus: functional parity + observability signals to validate SLA/cost tradeoffs.

High-level success criteria (proposal)
1) Latency: median < 120ms, p95 < 300ms for typical 512-token prompts.
2) Error rate: < 0.5% request errors.
3) Token throughput: sustained 200k/day (with short bursts up to 400k) without backpressure.
4) Observability: dashboards for latency percentiles, error breakdown, token throughput, KV cache hit rate, and end-to-end request traces for 90% of sampled requests.

Next steps
- Marissa: deliver observability onboarding packet (dashboards, tracing setup, log export instructions) by Mon 3/19 — will attach templates.
- Nimbus: confirm sample dataset and preferred time windows for test traffic by Fri 3/17.
- Karthik/Laura: coordinate procurement/compliance touchpoints if pilot extends to dedicated infra.

Attachments: provisional success metric sheet + dashboard sketches (will circulate).

Thanks — will stand by for the dataset and any tweaks to the criteria.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Emily Watson <emily.watson@nimbus.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@nimbus.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus pilot: quick recap and POC scope confirmation

Thanks Karthik — helpful recap. A few notes from our side after internal sync:

- Timeline: 2 weeks is fine, but our infra team prefers the pilot window 3/27–4/09 so we can coordinate load generation and compliance windows. Is that OK on your end?
- Success criteria: p95 target seems aggressive for the 13b model at our latency constraints; can we allow model-specific p95 targets (rwd-open-7b p95 < 250ms, rwd-open-13b p95 < 450ms)?
- Observability: we absolutely need KV cache hit rate and explicit per-region latency breakdowns (we test from US-east and EU-west). Also request that traces include downstream DB call durations so we can separate model service latency from app-layer latency.

We'll upload a 24k-record sample of typical prompts to the Drive folder by EOD Thu 3/16.

Emily
Emily Watson
Head of Product | Nimbus AI
emily.watson@nimbus.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Watson <emily.watson@nimbus.ai>, Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus pilot: observability onboarding packet + dashboard templates

Forwarding the observability pack for the pilot — PDF and dashboard PNGs attached. TL;DR of what's in the pack and who's doing what:

What we will deliver (by Mon 3/19) - Dashboard templates (Grafana JSON + screenshots) for:
  * Inference latency (p50/p90/p95/p99) by model and region
  * Request success/error breakdown (4xx/5xx/timeouts)
  * Token throughput and tokens-per-request distribution
  * KV cache metrics: hit rate, eviction rate, average KV size
  * Resource utilization: GPU % utilization, GPU memory, CPU for requester nodes

- Tracing plan: distributed tracing via OpenTelemetry; sample rate default 10% (configurable). Each trace will capture: request start/end, model decode time, KV lookup time, network time, and a span for any downstream DB call. We will provide the OTEL collector config and a small SDK snippet to add a trace header so your app can correlate upstream logic.

- Log export: structured JSON logs (ndjson) exported to your S3 bucket daily; field map included in the attachment. Logs include request_id, model_name, prompt_hash, token_count, latency_ms, error_code, kv_hit (true/false).

- Ownership and contacts:
  * Marissa Cole (SE) — observability rollout, dashboard import, trace config.
  * Laura Bennett (Customer Success) — success criteria sign-off, test schedule coordination.
  * Karthik Iyer (AE) — procurement/contract and timeline changes.

Proposed pilot timetable (revised to match Nimbus window)
- 3/19: Redwood delivers observability pack (this email + attachments).
- 3/20–3/24: Nimbus ingests sample dataset into staging, Reddit-style load generator dry run.
- 3/27: Pilot start (traffic ramp to target by EOD).
- 4/09: Pilot end. 4/10–4/12: joint evaluation and debrief.

Please see the attached "nimbus-poc-success-metrics.xlsx" for the exact numeric gates and an "observability-dashboards-sketch.png" with suggested panel layouts. Open to adjust sampling rates and p95 targets per model.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0110

Attachments: nimbus-poc-success-metrics.xlsx (attachment stub), observability-dashboards-sketch.png (attachment stub)
From: Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@nimbus.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Emily Watson <emily.watson@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nimbus pilot: observability onboarding packet + dashboard templates

Thanks Marissa — this is close to what we need. A couple of suggested edits to the success metrics sheet before sign-off:

1) Please add a separate KPI for cache warm-up behavior: target that KV cache hit rate >= 70% after 20k unique prompts (we run a warm-up phase).
2) For error breakdown, can you expose the raw error logs for any 5xx spikes (we'll need S3 path + retention of 90 days)?
3) Sampling: we'd like traces at 20% for the first 48 hours of the pilot (to diagnose startup issues) and then drop to 5% afterwards. Is that supported?

If you can incorporate those items and version the XLSX, we can sign off on the criteria and confirm the 3/27 start.

—Alex
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Watson <emily.watson@nimbus.ai>, Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus pilot: observability onboarding and success criteria (recap + next steps)

Appreciate the quick review and the specific asks, Alex. Short answers and next actions: 

- KV warm-up KPI: Marissa will add the 70% after 20k unique prompts row to the metrics sheet and include a brief warm-up procedure.
- Raw error logs: Redwood can push ndjson error artifacts to the S3 path you provide; retention 90 days is fine — Laura, can you coordinate the bucket policy and ensure secure transfer?
- Tracing sample rate: supported. Marissa will update the OTEL collector config to do 20% for the first 48h, then 5% thereafter.

I'll update the HubSpot deal stage to reflect pilot start 3/27 and copy procurement for the DocuSign route we discussed. If Nimbus confirms the 24k sample upload by Thu, Marissa and our infra team will do a staging dry-run next week.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting this underway.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
